dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談役です。相談に来てくださってありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 今日はよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.origin: お待たせしました。性別と年齢を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Sorry to keep you waiting. Could you please tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.origin: 26歳女です
dialogue.content: I'm a 26-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。今日はどういったご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 仕事のことなんですが
dialogue.content: It's about my work.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 残業とか長くて辛いんです
dialogue.content: The long overtime hours are really tough.

dialogue.origin: それは、しんどいですね。さしつかえなければどんなお仕事かお聞きしてもいいですか？
dialogue.content: That sounds very difficult. If you don't mind my asking, what kind of work do you do?

dialogue.origin: 不動産会社の営業事務です
dialogue.content: I'm a sales administrator at a real estate company.

dialogue.origin: 営業ですか、それは、不規則でしんどいですね。もうお仕事始めてどのくらいですか？
dialogue.content: Sales, I see. That can be irregular and demanding. How long have you been in this job?

dialogue.origin: 自分の仕事終わっても営業さんが帰ってくるまで待たされたりして
dialogue.content: Even when I finish my own work, I'm often made to wait until the sales staff gets back.

dialogue.origin: まだ１年ほどです
dialogue.content: It's only been about a year.

dialogue.origin: ご自分だけではどうにもならないこともおありなんですね。
dialogue.content: So there are things that are out of your control.

dialogue.origin: このまま続けていこうかご自分ではどうお考えですか？
dialogue.content: What are your own thoughts about continuing on as things are?

dialogue.origin: そこを悩んでます
dialogue.content: That's what I'm struggling with.

dialogue.origin: 続けたい気持ちもおありなんですね。でも、しんどいですよね
dialogue.content: So a part of you wants to continue. But it's also very tough, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: ただ上司の方はとてもいい人なんです
dialogue.content: It's just that my supervisor is a very nice person.

dialogue.origin: それはすてきですね。御相談とかもできそうな方なんですか？
dialogue.content: That's lovely. Do you feel you could talk to them about this?

dialogue.origin: でも会社の方針だし、上司に相談するのはどうなんだろうって
dialogue.content: But it's company policy, so I'm not sure about bringing it up with my supervisor.

dialogue.origin: 会社の方針が残業は当たり前っていうことなんでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Is the company policy that overtime is just expected?

dialogue.origin: お仕事の内容的にはいかがなんですか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about the content of the work itself?

dialogue.origin: そうみたいです
dialogue.content: It seems that way.

dialogue.origin: 内容はWEB管理です
dialogue.content: The work itself is web administration.

dialogue.origin: そのお仕事の内容自体には、しんどさは特には感じていらっしゃらない？
dialogue.content: So you don't feel that the content of the work itself is particularly difficult?

dialogue.origin: 時間的なことが問題ということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So the main issue is the time commitment?

dialogue.origin: 仕事はきつくないです
dialogue.content: The work itself isn't demanding.

dialogue.origin: 時間的な拘束ですね、きついのは
dialogue.content: It's the time commitment that's tough.

dialogue.origin: 社長も近くにいるけど、声はかけづらいですし
dialogue.content: The company president is nearby, but it's hard to approach them.

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら、あなたと同じようにしんどさや不満を感じていらっしゃる方もあるかもしれないですね。
dialogue.content: Perhaps there are others who feel the same strain and frustration that you do.

dialogue.origin: それが、この仕事　営業事務してるのは私だけなんです
dialogue.content: The thing is, I'm the only one in this sales administration role.

dialogue.origin: ほかは営業さんなので普通に待ってます
dialogue.content: Everyone else is in sales, so for them, it's normal to wait.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。では、ちょっと愚痴をこぼそうとしても、その相手もなかなかいないですね
dialogue.content: I see. So even if you wanted to vent a little, there's really no one to talk to.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよ
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: 営業さんにも言えないですよね。うっかり言ったら相手を責めてるように思われても辛いですよね
dialogue.content: And you can't really say anything to the sales staff, can you? It would be tough if you said something and they felt like you were blaming them.

dialogue.origin: でも、もしかしたら営業さんもしんどさをかかえているかもしれないですよね
dialogue.content: But it's possible the salespeople are carrying their own difficulties, too.

dialogue.origin: 多分顔や態度に出ちゃったことがあったのか、ちょっと嫌味言われたりしました
dialogue.content: I think it must have shown on my face or in my attitude at some point, because someone made a snide remark to me.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあったんですね。ならよけいに、残業が辛いとは言いづらいですよね
dialogue.content: I see, so that happened. That makes it even harder to say that the overtime is tough, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: それもそうですね文字打つの遅くてすみません
dialogue.content: You're right about that. Sorry, I'm a slow typer.

dialogue.origin: いえいえとんでもないです。私こそ、うまく噛み合わないところがあってすみません
dialogue.content: Not at all. If anything, I'm the one who should apologize if parts of our conversation haven’t flowed smoothly.

dialogue.origin: お一人でやってらっしゃるということですが、前任者の方とかはどうだったんでしょう？
dialogue.content: You mentioned you're the only one in the role; what about the person who was here before you?

dialogue.origin: WEB管理業務を雇うのは初めてらしいです
dialogue.content: Apparently, this is the first time they've hired for a web administration role.

dialogue.origin: なので引き継ぎとかもあまりなかったし
dialogue.content: So there wasn't much of a handover.

dialogue.origin: 初めてのことで、会社の方も手探りのところおあるのかおしれませんね
dialogue.content: Since this is new for them, the company might also be figuring things out as they go.

dialogue.origin: ええ。だから逆にもしかしたら、話せばわかってもらえるかもなのかな
dialogue.content: Yes. So maybe... if I talk to them about it, they might understand after all.

dialogue.origin: っていま思いました
dialogue.content: I just thought of that.

dialogue.origin: ええ。会社の方々もあなたのお気持ちまでは思い至ってないかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes. It's possible the people at your company haven't even considered how you feel.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり一度上司に話してみようかな
dialogue.content: Maybe I should try talking to my supervisor after all.

dialogue.origin: 軽いお茶のみ話からでも、少しお気持ちを伝えてみることはいいことだと思います
dialogue.content: I think it would be a good idea to share a little of how you feel, even if you start with just a casual chat.

dialogue.origin: お話しくださってありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing this with me.

dialogue.origin: そうですねなんだか道が見えた気がしました。今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: You're right. I feel like I can see a way forward now. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: 少しずつきもちがかるくなるようにできるといいですね。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: I hope things can start to feel a little lighter for you, little by little. Thank you.

topic.sub: 残業によるストレスとコミュニケーションの課題
